sentences.text:
Applicant :- Ratan Lal Yadav
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. And 3 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Amit Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.

1. Heard Sri Amit Singh, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Ravish Chandra Mishra,
the learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
2.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
172 of 2016, under Sections 376-D, 506 I.P.C. and Section 5g/6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, and Section 3(2)(v) of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989, registered at Police Station Ram Nagar, District Barabanki.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

entities.text: Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
entities.label: STATUTE

entities.text: Police Station Ram Nagar, District Barabanki
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of F.I.R. lodged on 02.07.2016 against three named accused persons, including the applicant in furtherance of an application under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C filed on 05.06.2016, alleging that all the three accused persons had raped the informant's daughter aged about 13 years on 26.05.2016.

The F.I.R alleges that one Brijesh Gautam and several other persons had reached on the spot after hearing the hue and cry raised by the victim and the accused persons went away after threatening the said persons with a pistol.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., she stated that when her mother reached on the spot the accused persons had already gone away.
5. In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., she stated that co-accused Naumi Lal had taken her on the point of a pistol and all the accused persons raped her.
6. In the medico legal examination report of the victim, no injury has been reported on any part of her body.

In the pathological examination report, no spermatozoa or gonococci has been reported,
the age of the victim has been opined to be 18 years as per her medical report.

7. The learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that co-accused Naumi Lal, has already been granted bail by means of an order dated 17.05.2018 passed by a coordinate bench of this Court in Bail Application No. 3192 of 2018.
8. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer of the bail, but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

9. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the aforesaid discrepancies mentioned in the order, coupled with the fact that the co-accused Naumi Lal against whom there is an allegation of threatening of the victim with a pistol has already been granted bail and without making any observations which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the applicant is also entitled to be released on bail.
10. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

11. Let the applicant-Ratan Lal Yadav be released on bail in Case Crime No. 172 of 2016, under Sections 376-D, 506 I.P.C. and Section 5g/6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act,
2012, and Section 3(2)(v) of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act,
1989, registered at Police Station Ram Nagar, District Barabanki, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Magistrate/Court concerned, subject to the following conditions: -
(i) the applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence;
(ii) the applicant shall not pressurize the prosecution witnesses;
(iii) the applicant shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial court.
12.
